The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] '''LCT laser trip''' was a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] emplacement security device that detected living beings who passed through its beam.

It required a larger [[Computer/Legends|computer system]] to operate and send a warning signal to it. Corridors used to place a series of beams at vertical increments of half a [[meter/Legends|meter]].

A pair costed 350 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
